posts.name: Manish Khatri
posts.cooked:
My laptop recently stopped working so i borrowed another laptop to do the BPT3, But since i changed my laptop I’m not able to access the vm.

the issue I’m getting : Permission denied (public key)

Can you anyone guide what should i do?

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Follow the steps at https://se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in/passwordless to create an ssh key from this new laptop like you had done in your old laptop once. Copy the newly generated public key and upload it in the form in the same URL.

now you will be able to access from new laptop.

If you want to access from old laptop again, simply copy the already existing public key in the old laptop and paste it in the above link. (no need to regenerate key).

Regards

posts.name: Manish Khatri
posts.cooked: Thanks Sayan, So now I can access my VM. What i did was used the command ssh-keygen then i copied the key from .ssh/rsa_id.pub and pasted it to the given site… just to confirm is it correct.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
It is correct.

If u want to use old laptop to access vm again, you need to do only steps 2 and 3 (assuming you have not deleted the key that existed in that laptop, otherwise you’d have to do step 1 too)
